title: Basic Tags and Page Structure
description: Learn about the essential HTML tags that form the structure of a web page.

flashcards.question: What are the three main sections of a basic HTML page?
What is the purpose of the <html> tag?
flashcards.answer: It wraps all the content of an HTML document and represents the root element.

flashcards.question: What kind of information goes inside the <head> tag?
flashcards.answer: Metadata like the title, links to stylesheets, scripts, and meta tags.

flashcards.question: What content is placed inside the <body> tag?
flashcards.answer: All the visible content such as text, images, links, and other elements.

flashcards.question: Name at least three heading tags in HTML.

What is the purpose of the

tag?
flashcards.answer: It defines a paragraph of text.

flashcards.question: How do you add a comment in HTML?
Which tag is used to add a line break?
What is the difference between block-level and inline elements?
flashcards.answer: Block-level elements start on a new line and take full width; inline elements flow within text.
